summary: Tested JPNS Shop the Tea feature end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases passed (GET /api/shop/product returns Jewells Herbal Magic Blend @ 2500 usd, POST /api/payments/checkout qty=1 and qty=3 both return cs_* session_id + checkout.stripe.com URL, qty=3 persists amount=7500 in DB, GET /api/payments/status/{id} works for fresh session (pending) and returns 404 for unknown id). Frontend: /shop page renders product image, $25.00 price, qty selector with +/- working (1->3->2), Apple Pay/Card/Cash App badges, checkout-btn redirects to checkout.stripe.com. Navbar 'Shop' link sits between Impact and Contact and routes to /shop. /payment/cancel renders 'Checkout cancelled' message.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: stripe.error.InvalidRequestError fallback on automatic_tax is good, but swallows all InvalidRequestError (incl. unrelated). Consider inspecting e.code == 'tax_not_configured' before falling back.
Backend: /api/payments/status updates DB inside GET handler — acceptable for polling but has a small race where a non-paid record can be overwritten; the $ne:'paid' guard mitigates this.
Backend: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY has a hard-coded 'sk_test_emergent' fallback — minor, but better to fail fast if env missing.
Shop.jsx: On checkout failure, state is reset but if axios resolves then navigation happens before React re-renders (fine). No unmount cleanup needed.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST payment_transactions in Mongo via real Stripe test-mode checkout sessions (session_ids captured during tests). Left as-is (Stripe sandbox sessions, no real funds).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payments feature validated against real Stripe sandbox. Use /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py as regression. Frontend checkout click redirects to checkout.stripe.com — do NOT try to complete the Stripe-hosted page.
